scene rocketshadowlegends
HI AGAIN! STILL HERE!
scene cookingwithkaori1
: F...Food! What...does it mean?
scene cookingwithkaori2
: What is your response?!
: Wait, this isn’t actually a trivia contest, is it? I thought Ayane and Io were doing that one?
: The question was rhetorical! And you have failed!
scene cookingwithkaori3
: How did I get a rhetorical question wrong?!
: Food is...the building block of...all humanity! It is...the powerhouse of...the cell!
: That’s supposed to be mitochondria!
scene cookingwithkaori4
: Just let her read her notes, Noriko! Kaori wanted to prepare a speech before the contest when she found out it was going to be televised. She’ll get to the rules soon enough, I’m sure.
: Which brings us...to the rules!
: See?
scene cookingwithkaori5
: Two girls...two human hearts. And what better to warm the human heart than...food?
scene cookingwithkaori6

: Welcome to the Route 69 Diner! My name is Kaori Kadowaki and I am the greatest waitress in all of Kumon-mi! But you may refer to me as the Queen of Spiders, the Greatest Waitress in All of Kumon-mi!
: We’re not actually at the rules yet, are we?
: As the new owner of this food and beverage establishment, I have paused all sales for the day to assist in this War of the Dorms! Please help yourself to my eggs!
: Girl.
scene cookingwithkaori7
: Yes! Girl! Two girls! Who will have one hour to prepare an...assortment of dishes that will be judged by...myself and my daughterbug! And perhaps a surprise third guest who...lives inside of me!
scene cookingwithkaori8
: Do you have relations with the cotton candy girl?
: Are you...talking about my sister? And also, do you mean a relationship? Because I don’t want to accidentally give you the wrong idea.
: She is currently mad at me for engaging in sexual intercourse with who she says is her manfriend.
: Oh hey, me too.
: Does this mean I should erase her name from my friendship journal? I do not know the rules of adultery.
: Uhh...K...Kaori? Maybe just...get back to the rules, please?
: Sorry, we can talk more about this later. You need to finish telling us how this contest works before Uta gets worked up and sneaks away to the bathroom for an extended period of time.
: Who do you think I am?! Sana?! Kirin?! Rin?! Molly?! Nodoka?! Sana?!
: Objection. If I wanted to pleasure myself in public, I would. I gain nothing from hiding away in a bathroom.
scene cookingwithkaori9
: A-As I was saying...the rules are simple! You have...sixty minutes to complete an assortment of dishes and...whoever’s food is...the foodiest will...receive a point of war.
: Make the foodiest food. Got it.
: Girl.
scene cookingwithkaori10
: Chika, are you sure you can handle this? I’m not really confident in you working with knives and flames at the moment.
: And if you’re only like this because you’re worried my sister could show up at any moment, I could tell her to wait until later to-
: Interfere with my goals and it will be you who is cooked, Noriko.
: Like...as in defeated?
: No. I will chop you into pieces and grill your perfect body over an open flame.
scene cookingwithkaori11
: Aww, perfect? Really? Thank you!
: You know, a lot of people say that being a vegetarian is unhealthy when, in all actuality-
: Go.
scene cookingwithkaori12
: What, now?
: Yes! The contest has begun!
scene cookingwithkaori13
: I brought my own knife.
: So we can just use whatever’s behind us? There’s no cap on ingredients or anything?
: There is a larger box of cold that you may walk into in the backwards room. The foods there are bigger and closer to decay.
: Yeah, just these ingredients should be fine. Thanks.
scene cookingwithkaori14
: Uhh...Chika? I know you’re, like...really excited about meeting Niki or whatever. And I know you’re probably also mad at me right now after you tried feeding me a dead animal at the maid cafe-
: Wait, she did what?
: But I’m also, like, really worried about you going crazy and maybe hurting Noriko or yourself or whatever and I’d appreciate it if you’d put the knife down.
: I have to make a delicious meal. You need a knife to make a delicious meal.

: Then can I maybe help you or something? Kaori skipped a lot of the rules but I checked them out on the Dorm Wars website and it says you’re allowed a sous chef. And I’ve technically done this before, so-
: Is your name Sue?
scene cookingwithkaori15
: Uh...what?
: I didn’t think so. Now, get out of my house and stop being so cute. I need to focus so I can impress the queen with my FOOD.
scene cookingwithkaori16
: Cutting away from Chika for a second, pun intended, it looks like Noriko brought her own knife as well! Though, I’m not sure it’s quite up to code...

: You never know when the knife strapped to your thigh will come in handy! And what I’ve learned after all these years of accidentally cutting myself with it is that it basically just never does. But that all ends today...
scene cookingwithkaori17
: Now, a lesser chef would probably tell you that using a potato peeler to, you know, peel potatoes...is much easier, safer, and cuts back on food waste.
: But what they won’t tell you that a knife, for those who are experienced with them, is way more precise and helps easily carve out eyes like you see on this little guy here.
: Didn’t you just say you never get to use yours, though?
scene cookingwithkaori18
: I don’t get to use my pocket knife. But that’s mostly just because my parents don’t let me when I help out with prep at the restaurant.
: Think most of us forgot that was even a part of your character, Noriko.
: Well, maybe now you won’t! I’m actually a pretty good cook. And I would have won last year’s cooking contest too if it wasn’t for the fact that I love Yumi so much.
: You know, you can always just not do that.
: Hi, Yumi! I love you!
: Kaori, you got a bathroom over here by any chance? I wanna go work on my Futaba impression for a bit.
: You mean be really cute and wholesome and sneak away to read elf smut?
: Turn west around the next right angle to reach the room of bathing! Enjoy your elves.
: I don’t...ugh!
scene cookingwithkaori19
: I’ll just fuckin’ stand here and mind my own business. Ain’t like I can really take sides in the contest anyway.
: Can you, like...not make fun of my friend when she’s not even here to defend herself, please?
: Can you, like...fuck off and mind your own business?
: Can you all like “shut up” while I’m trying to fucking COOK?
: On that note, Chika, what can you tell us about your dish today? What are you making, exactly?
: MEAT.
: Where’d ya even find meat that size? Looks like it came off a friggin’ elephant.
: Did you murder an elephant, Chika? Is this the same animal you apparently tried to feed Rin in the place where we work? Are you trying to get us closed down?
scene cookingwithkaori20
: I don’t know what I’m doing anymore. Everything has seemed blurry for weeks now. And the only person who can save me is not here yet. When will she be here?
: You’re talking about Niki, I presume?
: Girl.
: So you really ain’t at all bothered by the fact that she just randomly claimed Sensei as her property outta nowhere? Thought you loved him or whatever?
: I love both of them.
: And you don’t feel betrayed by either one? Because Sensei’s one thing, but idols are supposed to remain pure, aren’t they?
: Yeah. And she’s been out here gettin’ raw-dogged by Sensei’s massive wiener since they were kids.
: ‘Less it ain’t always been that big. But that’s even crazier because that means maybe she banged small-wiener Sensei and none of us ever even got that chance cause we weren’t born yet.
: Anything to add to that, Chika?
: Ask me again after I kill you.
: Noted.
scene cookingwithkaori21
: That just brings us over to Noriko, though! Who is significantly less dangerous, much to the surprise of everyone who was very scared of her after she was introduced to the class!
: MEAT.
: Are those all vegetables over there? How the heck d’ya plan to make a variety of dishes without addin’ even a little protein?
: It’s not like vegetables don’t have any protein, Miku. There are plenty of high-protein options outside of meat. Like chickpeas or spinach, for example. Or even corn as you’ll see soon.
: So yes, while Chika’s MEAT might beat out my spread in terms of protein alone, it’s combining all sorts of nutrients that helps keep us healthy and maintain apparently perfect bodies like mine.
: So you’re saying you’re not at all worried that your opponent has gone in the complete opposite direction with her cooking?
scene cookingwithkaori22
: Oh, not at all. It’s my goal today to show people that vegetarian food can be appetizing and to subsequently break the stigma that we all survive off of avocado toast and veggie burgers.
: I’ve gotta say, Noriko, I’m not at all surprised by your determination! And I’d even go as far as saying this is the most actual cooking we’ve had in a cooking contest so far!

: Yeah, well, that’s just what happens when you pit two people against each other who can actually cook. And if Chika wasn’t so broken right now, I’m sure she’d be able to come up with something great too.
: Cooking for children might seem easy, but kids can be some of the pickiest eaters out there. And I have a lot of respect for her and what she does for her sister on a daily basis.
: Then, let me ask you this — how many times have you had sex with Sensei so far?
scene cookingwithkaori23
: What?
: You heard her. We wanna know what we wanna know.
: Is it more or less than Chika has?
: Is this really relevant to the cooking competition?
: No, but Imani isn’t paying attention right now and nothing we say on TV ever has any sort of measurable consequences.
: Spill it, lady. How often’s he porkin’ ya and how come your sister ain’t got a problem with it?
: Ch...Chika’s definitely done it with him more than I have. I’m still new to all of this, to be honest.
: And your sister hasn’t entirely disowned you yet because?...
: Because she is broken beyond repair and incapable of envisioning a life without him. Can we go back to talking about food, please?
: Nope. That’ll be all. Thank you, Noriko.
scene cookingwithkaori24
: Are you really making fuck to all of these girls, Friend? How have you not run out of human juice yet?
: Not all of them. Just...most.
: This fills my body with feelings other than sex heat and makes me want to slap them with my human arm-feet.
scene cookingwithkaori25
: That’s probably jealousy, Kaori. You’re likely not far off from wanting to keep me to yourself too. It’s natural progression for girls like you who fall victim to my penis.
: I am a victim of your penis? Have you been attempting to hurt me with it this whole time?
: Maybe a little, sure. But mostly just for my own pleasure.
: Interesting. Because it hasn’t hurt at all.
: Not even a little.
: Maybe if it was bigger, you would be able to injure me with it.
scene cookingwithkaori26
: Are you trying to get a rise out of me or is that just a side effect of your underlying obliviousness concerning all things sexual?
: It is rising? Right now?
: Yes, but not because I want it to.
: The cotton candy girl told me I am no longer allowed to mate with you. But I am also not willing to say no to you if you want to because doing the sex makes me feel very good.
: But maybe this is just my instincts causing me to crave impregnation so that we don’t die out as a species.
scene cookingwithkaori27
: Silence your judgement, Nao-chan! It means nothing when you crave the same thing!
: I’m just going to keep standing here because I feel like doing anything else will just get me in trouble.
scene black
The next forty minutes of waiting for the competition to end were painful, but not because they were slow.
It’s because every minute is painful and I am not meant to be here.
scene cookingwithkaori28
: W...Welcome back to food! We will now review...the food!
scene cookingwithkaori29
: Chicken Chosokabe! Please tell us about your dish!
: Of course.
: MEAT.
: Did she just call you “Chicken Chosokabe?”
c" It’s my full name. "
scene cookingwithkaori30
: Norman Nakayama!
: Hai! Norman desu.
: Please provide foodular details. Thank you.
: Right! So, what we have here is an assortment of seasonal vegetables prepared two ways.
: The raw ones you see on the left were hand-picked based on beauty and freshness and cut into sticks that you may dip into fresh hummus you’ll find inside of the kabocha.
: The veggies on the right have been sautéed in sunflower oil and seasoned with just a little bit of salt and red pepper to bring out more of their natural flavor.

: In addition to that, we have some grilled corn on the cob, coated and doused in garlic butter made with the help of local grass-fed, free-range cows who also provided the milk used in the bean sprout chowder with chives you see above it!
: And finally, to the right of that, we have white rice, tsukemono, and miso soup with wild mushrooms to serve as a palate cleanser between dishes.
scene cookingwithkaori31

: I wanted to make Chinese doughnuts and flourless chocolate cookies for dessert as well, but I ran out of time and decided it would be best to just tidy up the presentation of the veggie sticks instead.
: Show-off.
scene cookingwithkaori32
: Huh?

: Right! So I have reviewed both dishes with Nao-chan and we have decided that Norman wins because her food tasted better, looked better, and did not involve the mindless slaughter of a protected species.
: Those elephants died for nothing because of you, Noriko. I hope you’re happy.
scene cookingwithkaori33
: I just wanted to show people that vegetables can be good too! Don’t pin this violence on me!
: I would have won if I cooked you.
: Yeah, because I wouldn’t have been able to compete!

: Norman’s victory brings the score of this competition to...a tie! Each floor now has one point. But things are...just getting started! And our next competition raises the question of...what it means to be...family!
scene cookingwithkaori34
: Please join us at the Chicken’s house to find out...what happens next in the sixth annual...Dorm Wars!
: Aaaaaand scene! Sponsors?!
